name: Contract basics
description: Common terms of a contract. Works for NDAs, service and contractor agreements.

fields.label: Term of the agreement
fields.description: how long the agreement lasts or when it ends

fields.label: Termination notice
fields.description: written notice needed to terminate the agreement

fields.label: Governing law
fields.description: which state or country law governs the agreement

fields.label: Payment terms
fields.description: amount, rate or schedule of payment for the services

fields.label: Non-compete
fields.description: whether the agreement contains a non-compete clause
